title: Sound Effects and Music with ElevenLabs
desc:
ElevenLabs can generate sound effects and full songs from text. This episode covers the Sound Effects playground and its settings (duration, looping, prompt influence), how to prompt simple and complex effects, audio terms the model understands, then Eleven Music: the song workflow, Audio Reference, Finetunes, section editing, prompting, and the Music v2.5 and v2 models.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
